HII.thesis_one_line: America's only maker of nuclear aircraft carriers, priced cheaply against a huge Navy order book, but its cash flow is lumpy and thin-margin.
kill_criteria: FY26 free cash flow guidance ("FY26 free cash flow between $500 and $600 million") cut below $500m, or H2'26 FCF (Q3+Q4) under $700m.
FY26 shipbuilding operating margin guide (current range 6.0%-6.5%) cut below the 6.0% low end, or shipbuilding segment margin under 5.0% in two consecutive quarters.
Net unfavourable cumulative catch-up adjustments above $100m operating income in any single quarter (Q2'26: net +$10m).
Total backlog below $50bn at any quarter-end (30 Jun 2026: $57.3bn).
Consolidated net debt/EBITDA (operating income plus D&A, from the 10-Q/10-K) above 3.5x (about 2.6x now).
key_adverse_facts: H1 2026 free cash flow about -$611m against a full-year guide of $500-600m (needs $1.1-1.2bn in H2); cash $12m at 30 Jun 2026
Q2 2026 net +$10m cumulative catch-up helped EPS by $0.20 (vs -$0.20 a year ago) despite a -$48m unfavourable adjustment on USS George Washington RCOH
EPS includes $213m non-operating pension benefit (about $4.4/share after tax)
2024 Newport News welding-quality investigation unresolved; COVID reinsurance claim lost at summary judgment in Apr 2026 (appealed)
FY24 FCF only $40m; thin 5-6% margins on fixed-price work
data_conflicts: yfinance/d4 EBITDA $1.17bn and TTM FCF -$300m differ from my filing-based TTM FCF about -$79m (Q3'25 16 + Q4'25 516 + Q1'26 -461 + Q2'26 -150) and EBITDA about $1.03bn (operating income + D&A)
Q4'25 FCF of $516m is derived (FY25 $800m less first nine months), not quoted
d4 next earnings 2026-10-29 is an estimate
HII.confidence_in_thesis: medium: backlog and demand are verifiable; FCF delivery and estimate changes are not yet proven

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for HII, so v1_verdict and v1_base_3y are null; dossier base case (+9.6%/yr) is from my own EPS/multiple build and reverse DCF (implied 5.4% FCFF CAGR at 9% WACC vs 7% base).

DDOG.thesis_one_line: Fast-growing software that monitors company computer systems, but its price assumes growth even better than our best case while its biggest customer is cutting back.
kill_criteria: Q3'26 revenue below $1.135bn (low end of the guided "Revenue between $1.135 billion and $1.145 billion.") or FY26 revenue guidance cut below $4.45bn.
Reported YoY revenue growth below 20% in two consecutive quarters before end-2027 (Q3'26 guide implies about 28-29% and Q4'26 about 25%, derived).
Trailing-12-month dollar-based net retention falls below 115% (currently "low-120%'s").
Non-GAAP operating margin below 20% in two consecutive quarters, or equity SBC above 25% of revenue (FY25 21.9%).
Diluted weighted share count growth above 4% YoY (Q2'26: +3.4%).
key_adverse_facts: 10-Q: 'We saw a reduction in usage from our largest customer starting in the third quarter of 2026, which may cause a deceleration in revenue growth.'
Q3 2026 revenue guide $1.135-1.145bn implies +28-29% YoY vs +36% in Q2; implied Q4 about +25%
SBC about $0.75bn FY25 (21.9% of revenue); SBC-burdened TTM FCF about $240m (0.2% yield) vs reported FCF $1,073m
Diluted shares +3.4% YoY; $1.0bn converts due 2029 with $217.60 conversion price, in the money
Heavy insider selling (503 sale transactions in 90 Form 4s since 26 Mar 2026; no purchases); reincorporated Delaware to Nevada 21 Apr 2026
data_conflicts: d4/yfinance market cap $96.3bn uses 334.9m Class A shares; I use 371.0m diluted (Q2'26 weighted) = $99.5bn
d4 trailing EPS $0.49 (GAAP) vs non-GAAP guidance $2.50-2.54: different bases, labelled
Largest customer is unnamed in filings; OpenAI attribution comes only from press/analyst reports
DDOG.confidence_in_thesis: medium on the business, high that the price is demanding; thesis cannot be sized until Q3/Q4 show the impact of the largest-customer cut

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for DDOG, so v1_verdict and v1_base_3y are null; reverse DCF implies 25-29% FY26-35 revenue CAGR (20% only at an 8% discount rate) vs my base 13% and bull 20%.

DDOG.scenario_basis: Start FY26E revenue $4.46bn (guide $4.45-4.47bn), non-GAAP EPS $2.52; base revenue FY30 $8.9bn (NTM $8.6bn) x 11x EV/sales + $8.6bn net cash over 394m shares = about $263 vs $268.13; bear 6x on $6.75bn; bull 14x on $9.75bn; no dividend.

KMB.thesis_one_line: Kleenex and Huggies maker, cheap with a 5% dividend, but it cut its 2026 outlook and is buying Tylenol-maker Kenvue with debt.
kill_criteria: Kenvue acquisition not closed by 31 Mar 2027 or terminated (either side owes a $1.1bn fee in specified cases).

FY26 organic sales growth guide cut again (currently "approximately 100 basis points below its weighted average category growth") or adjusted operating profit growth guide cut below mid-single digits.
Pro forma consolidated net debt/adjusted EBITDA at close above 3.25x (my estimate 2.6-2.9x) or a credit-rating downgrade below BBB.
Dividend cut, or trailing-12-month free cash flow below dividends paid for two consecutive quarters after closing.
Any acetaminophen judgment, settlement or accrual above $1bn, or a trial date set in the remanded MDL.
key_adverse_facts: 4 Aug 2026 outlook cut: organic growth now about 100 bps below category growth (prior in line to ahead); adjusted EPS attributable now low-single-digit decline (prior flat); adjusted EPS continuing ops high single digits (prior double digit)
China diaper social-media disruption (about 100 bps organic drag) expected to further hit sales and profits
Kenvue: Second Circuit vacated dismissal of acetaminophen autism/ADHD MDL in July 2026; Kenvue cannot estimate liability; Texas AG suit on appeal
Kenvue deal adds about 280m shares (current holders about 54%) and about $6.7bn cash consideration; my est. pro forma net debt about $18.3bn (2.6-2.9x EBITDA); no pro forma guidance yet
Dividend about $1.7bn a year roughly equals TTM FCF (about $1.9bn including IFP and a one-off insurance recovery); Q2 adjusted margin helped by one-time tariff refunds
data_conflicts: d4/yfinance FCF $941m and forward EPS $7.48 differ from my TTM FCF about $1.9bn (includes discontinued IFP and insurance recovery) and company bases (continuing vs attributable EPS)
b1 ROE 112% is an artefact of $1.75bn book equity
d4 next earnings 2026-11-03 not verified against company IR
Pro forma leverage and EPS are my estimates from KMB and Kenvue filings; the company has not published a pro forma leverage target
